statement.ru: Шрек сначала был героем детской книжки с картинками.
statement.en: Shrek started out as the hero of a children's picture book.

why: The 2001 film is based on William Steig's 1990 picture book Shrek!

statement.ru: Мультфильм «Тайна Коко» происходит в Японии.
statement.en: The cartoon Coco is set in Japan.

why: Coco is set in Mexico around the Day of the Dead.

statement.ru: Микки Мауса чуть не назвали Мортимером.
statement.en: Mickey Mouse was almost called Mortimer.

why: Walt's first choice was Mortimer Mouse; his wife Lillian suggested Mickey.

statement.ru: Уолт Дисней завещал заморозить своё тело.
statement.en: Walt Disney left instructions for his body to be frozen.

why: A long-standing urban legend; his daughter said there is no truth to it (he was cremated).

statement.ru: Самый первый «Оскар» за лучший фильм получило немое кино.
statement.en: The very first Best Picture Oscar went to a silent film.

why: Wings (1927), a silent film, won the first Outstanding Picture award.

statement.ru: Статуэтка «Оскар» отлита из чистого золота.
statement.en: The Oscar statuette is cast in solid gold.

why: It is gold-plated bronze, not solid gold.

statement.ru: Стич — инопланетный эксперимент под номером 626.
statement.en: Stitch is alien experiment number 626.

why: Stitch is also known as Experiment 626.

statement.ru: В первой «Истории игрушек» Базз Лайтер сразу знает, что он игрушка.
statement.en: In the first Toy Story, Buzz Lightyear knows from the start that he is a toy.

why: Buzz genuinely believes he is a real space ranger.

statement.ru: Рататуй — это овощное блюдо.
statement.en: Ratatouille is a vegetable dish.

why: A Provençal stew of summer vegetables; the Pixar film is named after it.

statement.ru: Дарта Вейдера в первых фильмах играл и озвучивал один и тот же актёр.
statement.en: In the first films, one and the same actor played and voiced Darth Vader.

why: David Prowse wore the suit; James Earl Jones gave the voice.

statement.ru: Больше всех «Оскаров» в истории получил Уолт Дисней.
statement.en: Walt Disney won more Oscars than anyone else in history.

why: He holds the record for most Academy Awards won by an individual (22 competitive).

statement.ru: «Холодное сердце» снято по сказке братьев Гримм.
statement.en: Frozen is based on a Brothers Grimm fairy tale.

why: Frozen is inspired by Andersen's The Snow Queen.

statement.ru: Студией Pixar когда-то владел Стив Джобс.
statement.en: Steve Jobs once owned the Pixar studio.

why: Jobs funded Pixar from 1986 and became its full owner in 1991.

statement.ru: Годзилла впервые появилась в американском фильме.
statement.en: Godzilla first appeared in an American film.

why: The first Godzilla film (1954) is Japanese.

statement.ru: Дамблдора после второго фильма о Гарри Поттере стал играть другой актёр.
statement.en: After the second Harry Potter film, Dumbledore was played by a different actor.

why: Richard Harris died in 2002; Michael Gambon took over from the third film.

statement.ru: «Унесённые ветром» — первый цветной фильм в истории.
statement.en: Gone with the Wind was the first colour film in history.

why: Becky Sharp (1935) was already a full three-strip Technicolor feature; GWTW is from 1939, and two-colour films came even earlier.

statement.ru: Тотошку в «Волшебнике страны Оз» играла собака-девочка.
statement.en: Toto in The Wizard of Oz was played by a female dog.

why: Terry, a female Cairn Terrier, played Toto.

statement.ru: Молнию Маккуина назвали в честь актёра Стива Маккуина.
statement.en: Lightning McQueen was named after the actor Steve McQueen.

why: He is named after Pixar animator Glenn McQueen, not Steve McQueen.

statement.ru: В «Корпорации монстров» город работает на энергии детского крика.
statement.en: In Monsters, Inc. the city runs on the energy of children's screams.

why: Monstropolis harnesses the screams of human children for energy.

statement.ru: Манеру Багза Банни грызть морковку взяли у Кларка Гейбла.
statement.en: Bugs Bunny's way of chewing a carrot was borrowed from Clark Gable.

why: Freleng, Jones and Clampett said it came from Gable eating a carrot in It Happened One Night.

statement.ru: Кота из «Тома и Джерри» сначала звали Джаспер.
statement.en: The cat in Tom and Jerry was first called Jasper.

why: In his debut, Puss Gets the Boot (1940), the cat was named Jasper.

statement.ru: Премию «Оскар» назвали в честь писателя Оскара Уайльда.
statement.en: The Oscar award was named after the writer Oscar Wilde.

why: The nickname's origin is disputed (Herrick's uncle, Bette Davis's husband, etc.); Wilde is not among the candidates.

statement.ru: «Паразиты» — первый неанглоязычный фильм с «Оскаром» за лучший фильм.
statement.en: Parasite was the first non-English-language film to win Best Picture.

why: Parasite (2019) was the first non-English-language Best Picture winner.

statement.ru: Гудение светового меча сделали из звука старых кинопроекторов.
statement.en: The hum of a lightsaber was made from the sound of old film projectors.

why: Ben Burtt mixed the hum of idling projector motors with TV interference.

statement.ru: Обычное кино снимают со скоростью 60 кадров в секунду.
statement.en: Ordinary cinema films are shot at 60 frames per second.

why: The standard for film is 24 frames per second.

statement.ru: Надпись на холме в Голливуде сначала была «Hollywoodland».
statement.en: The Hollywood sign on the hill first read "Hollywoodland".

why: Erected in 1923 as HOLLYWOODLAND to advertise a housing development.

statement.ru: Дональд Дак ходит без штанов.
statement.en: Donald Duck goes around without trousers.

why: He wears a sailor shirt, bow tie and cap but no pants.

statement.ru: Скуби-Ду — сенбернар.
statement.en: Scooby-Doo is a St. Bernard.

why: Scooby-Doo is a Great Dane.

statement.ru: Пумба из «Короля Льва» — бородавочник.
statement.en: Pumbaa from The Lion King is a warthog.

why: Pumbaa is a common warthog.

statement.ru: Эмблема студии MGM — рычащий тигр.
statement.en: The MGM studio's emblem is a roaring tiger.

why: MGM's mascot is Leo the Lion.

statement.ru: Акулу в «Челюстях» сыграла дрессированная белая акула.
statement.en: The shark in Jaws was played by a trained great white.

why: Training a real shark proved impossible; mechanical sharks nicknamed Bruce were built.

statement.ru: Чарли Чаплин родился в Америке.
statement.en: Charlie Chaplin was born in America.

why: Chaplin was born in London.

statement.ru: Настоящее имя Мэрилин Монро — Норма Джин.
statement.en: Marilyn Monroe's real name was Norma Jeane.

why: She was born Norma Jeane Mortenson.

statement.ru: Стивен Спилберг — один из основателей студии DreamWorks.
statement.en: Steven Spielberg is one of the founders of DreamWorks.

why: Founded in 1994 by Spielberg, Katzenberg and Geffen.

statement.ru: Самый первый «Оскар» за лучший анимационный фильм получил «Шрек».
statement.en: The very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature went to Shrek.

why: The category began at the 2002 ceremony, and Shrek won it.

statement.ru: В «Красавице и Чудовище» есть говорящий подсвечник.
statement.en: Beauty and the Beast has a talking candlestick.

why: Lumière is a servant turned into a talking candelabrum.

statement.ru: «Волшебник страны Оз» 1939 года цветной от начала до конца.
statement.en: The 1939 Wizard of Oz is in colour from start to finish.

why: The Kansas scenes are black and white tinted sepia; only Oz is in Technicolor.

statement.ru: Лампа с заставки Pixar — героиня собственного мультфильма.
statement.en: The lamp from the Pixar logo is the star of its own short film.

why: Luxo Jr. comes from the studio's 1986 short of the same name.

statement.ru: Джинн в «Аладдине» исполняет сколько угодно желаний.
statement.en: The Genie in Aladdin grants as many wishes as you like.

why: He grants his master three wishes.

statement.ru: В рёве тираннозавра из «Парка юрского периода» есть визг слонёнка.
statement.en: The T. rex roar in Jurassic Park contains a baby elephant's squeal.

why: Gary Rydstrom built the roar from an alligator, a big cat and a baby elephant's high scream.

statement.ru: Актёр, сыгравший Терминатора, был президентом США.
statement.en: The actor who played the Terminator was President of the United States.

why: Schwarzenegger was Governor of California (2003 to 2011), never President.

statement.ru: Джеймса Бонда в кино всегда играли британцы.
statement.en: James Bond has always been played by British actors.

why: George Lazenby, Bond in 1969, is Australian.

statement.ru: В оригинале ковбоя Вуди озвучил Том Хэнкс.
statement.en: In the original version, Woody the cowboy is voiced by Tom Hanks.

why: Tom Hanks is the voice of Woody in Toy Story.

statement.ru: Индиана Джонс больше всего боится пауков.
statement.en: Indiana Jones is most afraid of spiders.

why: His famous fear is of snakes.

statement.ru: Немое кино показывали в полной тишине.
statement.en: Silent films were shown in complete silence.

why: Showings almost always had live music: a pianist, organist or orchestra.

statement.ru: Ширли Темпл получила особый детский «Оскар» в шесть лет.
statement.en: Shirley Temple received a special juvenile Oscar at the age of six.

why: She got a special Juvenile Academy Award in February 1935, aged 6.

statement.ru: В книге, по которой сняли «Бэмби», Бэмби — косуля.
statement.en: In the book that Bambi is based on, Bambi is a roe deer.

why: Salten's Bambi is a roe deer fawn; Disney changed him to a white-tailed deer.

statement.ru: Тоторо — главный герой «Унесённых призраками».
statement.en: Totoro is the main character of Spirited Away.

why: The heroine is the girl Chihiro; Totoro is from My Neighbor Totoro.

statement.ru: Хичкок получил «Оскар» как лучший режиссёр.
statement.en: Hitchcock won the Oscar for Best Director.

why: He was nominated five times but never won Best Director.

statement.ru: Деревню хоббитов из «Властелина колец» можно посетить и сейчас.
statement.en: You can still visit the hobbit village from The Lord of the Rings today.

why: The Hobbiton set in New Zealand runs daily guided tours.
